summary: Alithya Group inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 13, 2026, reporting Q1 fiscal 2027 results and announcing it has retained Scotiabank as financial advisor in connection with a previously announced strategic review process. The company reported revenues of $105.1 million, down 15.4% year-over-year, and a net loss of $2.4 million. The strategic review aims to identify opportunities to maximize value for stakeholders. No specific deal terms were disclosed. The board's recommendation is not detailed. Financial metrics show declining performance. What to watch: potential sale, merger, or other value-maximizing transaction; risk-arb angle depends on future announcements.
